messages:
ellie: OK team, tiny late-night survey  what's your go-to 45min vinyl side + a 10min shout-read (poem/flash) for golden hour? no algorithmic playlists pls.
martin: Side A of Nick Drake's Pink Moon, always. For a short read, a Mary Oliver poem does the trick.
yasmin: For something less twee, try Stereolab side B (lots of texture) + a quick Italo short story excerpt.
spencer: If you want surf & nostalgia: The Beach Boys Pet Sounds side + a 10min comic strip reading (Calvin & Hobbes archive).
ellie: love the comic idea. @vin-bot any quick vinyl recs collated?
vin-bot: Quick match list: 1) Nick Drake - Pink Moon (side A) 2) Stereolab - Emperor Tomato Ketchup (side B) 3) The Beach Boys - Pet Sounds (side A) https://open.spotify.com/album/example :turntable:
martin: @yasmin what's your favorite Italo short? want a link to pre-download.
yasmin: I'll DM a PDF of "A Very Small Life" (short, bittersweet). 10min read.
spencer: also pro tip: run a tiny field recording of distant traffic under the first track to simulate sunset commute. sounds weirdly cinematic.
ellie: idea: micro-exchange next friday  bring one vinyl side + one short reading, 45min total. low effort.
yasmin: i'm in. can we make it themed? "late-summer decay" or "early fall glow"?
martin: late-summer decay gets my vote. could do a quiet cello side + a melancholy micro-fiction.
vin-bot: Event created: "Vinyl Sides & Short Reads: Late-Summer" 1864593600 (Fri 7pm local). Reminder scheduled 1864590000 (1hr prior).
ellie: RSVP: yes. i'll queue the vinyl and bring iced tea.
spencer: RSVP: yes. bringing portable amp and a small stack of comics.
yasmin: RSVP: yes. will pick a short that pairs with Stereolab textures.
martin: this thread is a gem. thanks for the mood planning, ellie. :sparkles:
ellie: happy to pilot. will post a tiny prompt/reminder midweek. if anyone wants to swap slots DM me.
